data.name: Microsoft_Crm_Msgbody_Default_fonts
data.comment: This defines the default font for the body of a new e-mail (although users can change the font at runtime by using the HTMLbar). Like the fonts listed in resource Microsoft_Crm_Web_Fonts, the order of the fonts matter, since IE will use the first font and go down the list until it finds the first font that is installed on the user's system. Therefore the most preferable font should be placed first in the list. However, unlike resource Microsoft_Crm_Web_Fonts, fonts that have spaces should only be enclosed in single quotes - double quotes will cause a formatting error. The list of fonts in this resource should be a proper subset of the list of fonts in resource Web._controls.htmlbar.defaultfonts.
